description:
What makes a shop accessible to people with needs, such as the blind/visually impaired, wheelchair users or those with autism and sensory issues?

UNIQLO Singapore rolled out its pilot Access initiative in 2023, and CNA Insider got three shoppers to test out its quiet-hour assisted shopping services, as well as wider walkways and a wheelchair-friendly fitting room. 

To book private hour sessions at UNIQLO's 51@Ang Mo Kio outlet, click here:  https://www.uniqlo.com/sg/en/spl/sustainability/uniqlo-access
